A standard piano has **88 keys** in total: **52 white keys** and **36 black keys**, spanning 7¼ octaves (from A0 to C8).

*(Note: If the "6" in your question meant **6 standard pianos**, that would be **528 keys** in total—312 white keys and 216 black keys! Or if you meant a **6-octave keyboard**, those typically have **73 or 76 keys**.)*
